VBO:0200424.summary: Affectionate yet comfortable with some time to himself, Smokey was described by his keeper as sensitive and responsive. He enjoyed walks, truck rides and squeaky toys, and rolled in mud holes despite refusing to swim. Born in February 2004, he came from Triple M Kennel’s foundation breeding for the Dakotah Shepherd, before the programme had its name.
VBO:0200424.shortDescription: Smokey’s keeper described an affectionate Dakotah Shepherd foundation dog who enjoyed walks, truck rides and squeaky toys.
